name: blog-style-guide-creator
description: Builds a brand's editorial style guide from its published articles, an existing brand kit or style document, or its editors' edits, then checks drafts against it with parallel reviewers whose every finding is verified. Includes proofreading and an optional fact-check.

guides_dir.title: Brand guides folder
guides_dir.description: Folder that holds one subfolder per brand (brand/style-guide.md). Leave empty to use a brands folder in the current project.

deep_model.title: Model for building guides
deep_model.description: Model alias for building and auditing guides: opus or fable.
